chunks: "There is no harm in all kinds of dyeing."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْخِضَابِ: dyeing, especially of the hair or beard
key_terms.كُلِّهِ: all of it; indicating generality and comprehensiveness
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is dyeing the hair or beard permissible in Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that dyeing is permissible in all its forms. The hadith indicates the general allowance of beautification through dyeing and the absence of prohibition in it.
